newsitem.title: USA: SatCon Technology gets $1.5 mln in pacts.
newsitem.headline: SatCon Technology gets $1.5 mln in pacts.

text.p: SatCon Technology Corp said on Thursday it was awarded two contracts from the Department of the Army for a total value of $1.5 million.

One project is to develop and demonstrate a high power density generator for vehicle use and a second project is to demonstrate a compact, light-weight turbine-alternator for power generation. Revenue from the programs is expected to be recognized in 1997.

SatCon designs, develops and manufactures "Active Motion Control" systems including advanced electric motors, high density power electronics, suspension systems, propulsion systems and flywheel energy storage systems for commercial and government customers.
